pn: Atideva. The Bodhisatta born as a Brahmin in the time of Revata Buddha. Having heard the Buddha preach he gave him his upper garment (Ja.i.35; Bv.vi.10; Mbv.10). He belonged to Rammavatī. Bv-a.134.
